disciplinary_grounds.description: False statements, representations, fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or in the practice of any branch of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False statements or representations or fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to the practice, or fraud or deceit in the practice of any branch of the healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance abuse rendering the licensee unfit for performance of professional obligations and duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Substance abuse rendering him unfit for the performance of his professional obligations and duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of any branch of the healing arts that causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient or patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of any branch of the healing arts that causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical incapacity or incompetence to practice with safety to patients and the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical incapacity or incompetence to practice his profession with safety to his patients and the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Restriction of a license to practice in another state, the District of Columbia, a U.S. possession or territory, or foreign jurisdiction, or for a federal entity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Restriction of a license to practice a branch of the healing arts in another state, the District of Columbia, a United States possession or territory, or a foreign jurisdiction, or for an entity of the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of any of the healing arts under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of any of the healing arts under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner of a like, similar, or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing any controlled substance with intent or knowledge that it will be used other than medicinally or for accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or dispensing any controlled substance with intent or knowledge that it will be used otherwise than medicinally, or for accepted therapeutic purposes, or with intent to evade any law with respect to the sale, use, or disposition of such drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and willfully committing a felony under federal or Virginia law, or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly and willfully committing an act that is a felony under the laws of the Commonwealth or the United States, or any act that is a misdemeanor under such laws and involves moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting, having professional connection with, or lending name to any person known to be practicing illegally any of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting, having professional connection with, or lending his name to any person known to him to be practicing illegally any of the healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of the applicable branch of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of his branch of the healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in such a manner as to be a danger to the health and welfare of patients or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in such a manner as to be a danger to the health and welfare of his patients or to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety because of illness or substance abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety because of illness or substance abuse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing an advertisement relating to professional practice that contains a claim of superiority or violates Board advertising regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing in any manner an advertisement relating to his professional practice that contains a claim of superiority or violates Board regulations governing advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of statute or regulation relating to the manufacture, distribution, dispensing, or administration of drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of statute or regulation, state or federal, relating to the manufacture, distribution, dispensing, or administration of drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or cooperating with others in violating any of the provisions of the applicable chapters or Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or cooperating with others in violating any of the provisions of Chapters 1 (§ 54.1-100 et seq.), 24 (§ 54.1-2400 et seq.) and this chapter or regulations of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual contact with a patient concurrent with and by virtue of the practitioner-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual contact with a patient concurrent with and by virtue of the practitioner and patient relationship or otherwise engaging at any time during the course of the practitioner and patient relationship in conduct of a sexual nature that a reasonable patient would consider lewd and offensive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction in any state, territory, or country of any felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction in any state, territory, or country of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of legal incompetence or incapacity in any state if still in effect and not restored
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication of legal incompetence or incapacity in any state if such adjudication is in effect and the person has not been declared restored to competence or capacity

written_practice_protocol_required.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations governing the practice of anesthesiologist assistants, including regulations for (i) application for and issuance of a license or renewal of a license, (ii) standards of practice for licensed anesthesiologist assistants, and (iii) requirements for supervision of anesthesiologist assistants by anesthesiologists.

supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.value: A physician who is licensed by the Board and who has completed a residency in anesthesiology approved by the American Board of Anesthesiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Anesthesiology
supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.quote: "anesthesiologist" means a physician who is licensed by the Board and who has completed a residency in anesthesiology approved by the American Board of Anesthesiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Anesthesiology.

national_certification_body.quote: Passage of the certifying examination administered by the National Commission for Certification of Anesthesiologist Assistants or other examination required by the Board.

student_trainee_exemption.quote: Nothing in this section shall prohibit a student anesthesiologist assistant who is enrolled in an anesthesiologist assistant program accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs or its predecessor or successor organizations from engaging in acts that would constitute practice as an anesthesiologist assistant as part of such program.
